notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source about this tower is the tnlandforms list, which gives coordinates and county only (no build date, design, height or status). Wikipedia's Colly Township page names Lagoon as a community; it does not mention a tower, and the story does not link the two. The Forest Lookouts North Carolina index does not list Lagoon. A weather-service page and a search snippet mention a Lagoon Fire Tower, but the cached copy of that page does not contain the phrase, so it is not cited. Status and access are left unknown. The story text is about 95 words, under the 120-word target because no further source was found. Fact-check 2026-10-21: removed the unsupported word 'last' from the map-revision sentence and reworded a sentence that copied the Wikipedia quote.
